message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from Alpha Vantage and Yahoo Finance without any checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code only fills NaN values and applies MinMaxScaler normalization; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering mechanisms.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models via `load_model` (Keras) and `pickle` (implied by `import pickle`) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection is performed before or during training in any of the code files.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in any of the code files.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train_test_split is used, there is no held-out test set isolation (shuffle=False but no separate validation set), no signed/hashed evaluation data, and cross_val_score is applied to X_test/y_test rather than a truly independent set, offering no meaningful protection against metric manipulation
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model output values (e.g., NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold validation) are present anywhere in the inference path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; no text-in/text-out model is used, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not implemented.
